title: Complicated Electronic Controls and iDrive
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G60’s electronic controls, touchscreen menus, and iDrive as overly complicated, while a few fragments mention electronic systems without a clear evaluative direction.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on electronic systems, touchscreen menus, iDrive, and overall technology being difficult to understand or more complicated than expected.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention learning the electronic systems, acceptable electronics, charging-network access, and fast electronic response, but the examples are too varied to support a single clear sentiment summary.

limitations: The undetermined examples mix unrelated subjects, including usability, charging-network access, and electronic response, so this topic is not fully coherent.
All examples come from the G60, so the summary does not extend beyond that model.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners.
